_comment: Editable content strategy. Weights are re-tuned weekly by engine/insights.py; everything else is yours. Days are Asia/Dhaka weekdays (mon..sun). Slots: morning=08:00 BST, evening=20:00 BST.

question.instruction: Open with a sharp one-line question the reader cannot answer without reading on.

mistake.instruction: Open by naming a common mistake students make with this word/idea — without statistics.

bold_true.instruction: Open with a bold but verifiable one-line claim about the news or the word.

story_open.instruction: Open mid-scene, like the first line of a short story.

number.instruction: Open with a concrete number that appears in the source (never invent one).

exam_angle.instruction: Open by connecting the word to an exam moment (BCS/Bank/Admission/IELTS) in one line.
